name: The Magma King
description: the Warden of the Ember Wastes, a huge hulking demon king made of cooling black slag and cracked obsidian, molten orange lava glowing through the cracks in his body, massive shoulders, thick arms and huge rock fists, a jagged crown of volcanic rock fused to his head with lava dripping from it, a heavy cloak of dripping lava, burning yellow eyes and a smug grin, with his great throne of piled black slag and glowing rock

poses.stand: slouched lazily on his huge throne of piled black slag and glowing rock, one elbow on the throne's arm, chin resting on his fist, smug and bored
poses.risen: standing up at his full height in front of his slag throne, fists clenched at his sides, the lava in his cracks still a dull orange glow

standing.action: still standing on his feet in front of his slag throne, now enraged: fists clenched, shoulders hunched forward, the cracks all over his body blazing bright yellow-white with molten light, lava pouring from his crown

dead.action: gone: only a heap of cooling slag rubble is left in front of his cracked, empty throne
dead.prompt: Image 1 shows a demon king standing in front of his throne. Remove the demon king completely: no body, no legs, no arms, no head left. In his place, on the ground in front of the empty throne, draw a low wide heap of cooling black slag rubble glowing orange in the cracks, with thin grey smoke rising from it and his jagged rock crown lying on top of the heap. The empty throne is split down the middle by a big glowing orange crack. Keep the throne, the art style, the size and the position the same as image 1. {background}

idle.action: sits slouched on his throne, breathing slowly, lava pulsing through his cracks, drumming the fingers of his free hand on the throne's arm

throw.action: stays seated, scoops a glowing molten boulder up from beside the throne and lobs it forward to the right with one arm, then slouches back

slamSeat.action: stays seated, lifts his fist and slams it down on the arm of his throne, lava splashing out along the floor to the right, then slouches back

hurt.action: flinches on his throne as he is struck, lava spurting from a crack in his shoulder, then settles back, annoyed

rise.action: pushes himself up off his throne with both arms and slowly stands up to his full height, rock grinding, slag crumbling off his body

enrage.action: throws his head back and roars as the cracks across his whole body flare from dull orange to blazing yellow-white, lava bursting from his crown

idleStand.action: stands enraged in front of his throne, chest heaving, molten light pulsing bright through his cracks, lava dripping from his fists

slam.action: raises both fists high over his head and slams them down onto the ground in front of him, a wave of lava bursting out along the floor to the right, then straightens up

breath.action: leans forward and breathes a long roaring gout of fire and molten lava to the right from his open mouth, then straightens up

hurtStand.action: is struck and staggers back half a step, lava spurting from a crack in his chest, then straightens up

die.action: roars, cracks split across his whole body, and he collapses into a smoking heap of slag at the foot of his throne as the throne cracks down the middle
